objective: Load all JSON schemas, validate their syntax and references, validate sample JSON data, and produce a validation report with remediation guidance.
prerequisites: Node.js (optional) or Python (optional) for automation scripts

steps.title: Inventory schemas
steps.description: List files in Assets/docs/schemas/ and record paths.

steps.title: Syntactic validation
steps.description: Parse each schema as JSON to detect syntax errors.

steps.title: Semantic/schema validation
steps.description: Validate schemas with a JSON Schema validator (AJV or equivalent) and resolve $ref references.

steps.title: Validate sample data
steps.description: Find sample JSON files and validate them against the corresponding schemas; record failures.

steps.title: Produce report
steps.description: Write validation-report.md summarizing results and suggested fixes.

steps.title: Optional automation
steps.description: Add scripts to automate validation using AJV (Node) or Python jsonschema.

notes: If schemas reference external URIs, consider mirroring them under Assets/docs/schemas/external/.
Prefer a validator that matches the schema draft in use (try Draft-07 and 2019-09 if unknown).
